PDF and PNG should match W ord: automatically wrapped lines reach both margins, while the
final line and any line ending at an explicit break remain ragged.
Automatic W rapping
Generated reports often contain prose assembled from several sources, and full justification must
remain stable when words have very different lengths. Every automatically wrapped line in this
paragraph should expand only its ordinary inter-word spaces to meet the right edge. The final line
must keep its natural width.
Mixed Inline Styles
The same spacing must continue through bold phrases, italic observations, highlighted words
with spaces, and an underlined review link with several words. Styling boundaries must not create
uneven gaps, move text outside the frame, or shorten the clickable area. This last line remains
ragged.
Explicit Line Break
This line deliberately ends at an explicit break and must remain visibly ragged.
The following text resumes as a separate logical line. If it wraps automatically, only those
automatically wrapped lines are justified; its short final line remains natural.
